name: Decatur
gaps: Parcels are SmartGov_Parcel_Layer_6_2025 (BainbridgeGA) (https://services5.arcgis.com/TIhHfn6hMXyrVHu4/arcgis/rest/services/SmartGov_Parcel_Layer_6_2025/FeatureServer/0). Published acreage is filtered to 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Source query returned 3546 rows; 3520 distinct parcel ids stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the geometry check.
Pass 2 enrichment is from rural-oz-pass2 csv (tax HTML-only, sale HTML-only, owner REST). GDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
Pass 2 tax is HTML-only. qPublic was not requested, and no tax value was copied from an HTML report.
Pass 2 sale is HTML-only. Zero-filled SALE_VAL columns are not stored as a sale price, and qPublic was not requested.
Property-appraiser links are filled from the pass-2 template with each parcel id and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
